Turn switch #8 of DIP switch #2 to the ON position and turn power ON. The MOON PATROL diagnostic program consists of 8 independent tests, 2 of which are automatic at turning power ON in diagnostic mode: RAM Test and ROM Test. After these two tests have been properly completed, pressing the 2 Player button brings an index of the other tests to the (RT display:
01 DIP SWITCH 02 1-0 PORT* 03 SOUNDS 04 CHARACTER 05 COLR 06 CROSS HATCH PATTERN
* Contro! Panel and Coin Door switches test.

As any test other than 02 is completed, pressing the 2-Player button returns the test index to the monitor display. When test 02 is completed, the joystick lever must be moved left while pressing the 2 Player bufton to return the test index. If no further testing is desired, turn power OFF and return switch #8 of DIP swith #2 to the OFF position.
!f checked to be OK, "RAM OK" appears on monitor. If not OK, "RAM NG XXXX yy 22" appears on monitor (without ROM test results). * Faulty RAM address RAM Input Data RAM Output Data

A faulty chip must be replaced to continue diagnostics.
